q: Which chemical imports into German chemical parks such as Rhine-Neckar or Leuna count for CBAM?
title: German chemical park imports under CBAM
short: Only a few: hydrogen, ammonia, nitric acid, potassium nitrate and nitrogen or mixed fertilisers are CBAM goods. Most organic chemicals, polymers, solvents and specialty chemicals are not in Annex I. Hydrogen imports need a declarant from the first tonne, because the 50 tonne exemption does not apply to it.
audience: Chemical companies and purchasing teams in the Rhine-Neckar region and the Central German Chemical Triangle

ul: 3102 and 3105: nitrogenous and mixed fertilisers, except 3105 60 00.

p: Organic chemicals in chapter 29, polymers in chapter 39, industrial gases other than hydrogen, and inorganic chemicals not listed in Annex I.

For hydrogen, only direct emissions count. For ammonia, nitric acid and fertilisers, direct and indirect emissions count, and ammonia's embedded emissions flow into nitric acid and fertilisers made from it.
